exposure: 13C-labeled fatty acids (oleic acid, linoleic acid, docosahexaenoic acid)
cohort: The study included ten obese and ten normo-weight pregnant women, all undergoing elective caesarean sections.
finding: Obese mothers, even without hyperlipidemia, exhibited a reduced materno-fetal transfer of polyunsaturated fatty acids, which could potentially impact fetal development.
mod_finding: All study participants underwent elective caesarean sections.
cross-section timing: 12 hours before elective caesarean section and at the time of birth
